name: trayce
description: Trayce — A lightweight, no-admin Windows 11 utility to view and clean up stale notification area (tray) icon records in your user registry. Built with Wails v2, Vue 3, and Naive UI. Offline-first: scans HKCU\Control Panel\NotifyIconSettings, auto-backs up before deletion, supports undo, and never touches HKLM or your files.
